d:
A luxury handbag was once a symbol of status. The more expensive it was, the more desirable it became.
But that formula is facing a reality check. From Gucci cutting prices to LVMH reporting falling sales, some of the biggest names in luxury are struggling to win over consumers.
China's slowdown, changing shopping habits and a new generation questioning the price tag are reshaping the industry. Is the French luxury dream losing its appeal? Prathik S Vinod breaks it down.
